reviews.text: Excellent service! Friendly and efficient whilst being reasonably priced.

The mobile groomer I'd used for the past 10 years sadly retired a couple of months ago so i had to find a new groomer.
Living locally in thought I'd give these a try and it's the first AND LAST time I'll be using this groomer.
I phoned the groomer, explained his needs and if her grooming him was possible and when assured by her she knows what shes doing i booked my dog in.
I turned up at the allotted time, explained how i wanted him trimming, and spoke about the phone conversation about his skin condition and that ANYTHING used had to be natural and NO PERFUME.
I went to pick him up and not only had they lathered him in perfume BUT they'd used standard shampoo which caused a massive flare up and my dog suffering for over a week being driven crazy by his skin.
Clearly this person either thinks she knows better, thinks i don't have a clue OR just completely ignores customers requirements and does as she pleases.
I DEFINITELY won't be using this groomers again and I certainly won't be recommending it to anyone as I don't want to be responsible for anything similar happening to someone I recommended them too.
Its a shame as its live practically opposite the shop BUT my dogs health comes before the locality of the shops location...🤬🤬🤬

The only reason I booked my dog here was really for a nail.trim.  admittedly he is a nervous dog so I asked for him not to be dried.  The trim was half attempted and I felt the groomer could not be bothered or did not know how to deal with the dog effectively.  Would go elsewhere in future.
Excellent service very friendly Max loved his stay  and looked amazing when we picked him up definitely go back again

Full grooming-we are very happy with services we received 😀.
